headline: Async standups without the meeting.
body: Share yesterday, today, and blockers asynchronously — when your team is ready.

home.featureClockBody: The reminder arrives at the start of your work day, in your time zone.
home.featureHelpBody: The summary leads with who is stuck, then today, then yesterday.
home.featureDigestBody: The daily summary is posted in Slack.
home.stepOneBody: Sign in and choose the team you are posting for.
home.stepTwoBody: Yesterday, today, and anything you need help with.
home.stepThreeBody: Needs help stays open. Yesterday stays collapsed.
home.closeBody: Sign in and write today's standup.

footer.legal: Vibe Standup is part of Silver Vibe™, a personal open-source project (MIT).

my.title: My standup
my.lead: Draft, submit, and review today’s team summary.
my.noTeams: You are not on any team yet.
my.closed: The standup is closed for today.
my.awayHint: These days are not counted as a missed standup.
my.recentWorkHint: These lines stay out of your standup until you accept one.
my.planHint: Preview plan {{plan}}: up to {{teams}} teams, {{members}} members per team (preview only — Nest still enforces the workspace planKey).
my.mentionHow: Type @ for people and # for issues.

team.title: Team admin
team.lead: Configure standup questions, invite members, and rebuild summaries.
team.inviteEmailHint: We'll email the invite when Resend is configured. You can always copy the link as a backup.
team.invitePending: Invite created, but email was not sent. Copy the link below and share it.
team.inviteEmailSent: Invite email sent. You can still copy the link below if needed.
team.inviteAccepted: Member added (they already had an account).
team.aiDigestNotice: If AI digests are enabled on the server, rebuilding or posting a digest may send today’s standup answers to Google Gemini for polishing. See the Privacy notice.
team.reminderHint: A window reminds people when it opens. A deadline reminds them at that time. Together mode posts the summary then.
team.revealTogether: All together at the standup time
team.slackChannelHint: Override the workspace Slack channel for this team’s standup digests. Connect Slack in Workspace admin first.
team.slackNotConnected: Slack is not connected for this workspace.
team.slackChannelSaved: Slack channel saved for this team.
team.linearTargetHint: Override the workspace Linear project for this team’s standup digests. Connect Linear in Workspace admin first.
team.linearNotConnected: Linear is not connected for this workspace.
team.linearTargetSaved: Linear project saved for this team.
team.githubTargetHint: Override the workspace GitHub repository for this team’s standup digests. Connect GitHub in Workspace admin first.
team.githubNotConnected: GitHub is not connected for this workspace.
team.githubTargetSaved: GitHub target saved for this team.
team.jiraTargetHint: Override the workspace Jira project for this team’s standup digests. Connect Jira in Workspace admin first.
team.jiraNotConnected: Jira is not connected for this workspace.
team.jiraTargetSaved: Jira target saved for this team.
team.reconnectAddon: The connection was rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Reconnect it in Workspace admin.
team.schedulePurpose: Choose when the team answers and when answers become visible.
team.scheduleLearnMore: Deadline means answer before a time. Window means answer between two times. Live reveal shows each answer as it arrives; Together waits until the standup time.
team.timezoneHelp: Use an IANA name such as Europe/Amsterdam. Members can still set their own hours in My settings.
team.scheduleKindHelp: Pick a single deadline or a start–end window for answering.
team.revealHelp: Live is best for async teams. Together keeps answers private until the cutoff.
team.questionsPurpose: These prompts appear on the web standup form in this order.
team.questionsTip: Built-in questions can be turned off but not deleted. Slack /standup currently uses text fields for yesterday, today, and blockers.
team.digestsPurpose: Choose where this team's digest is posted. Other chat tools are configured in Workspace admin.
team.digestsOtherCallout: Linear, GitHub, and Jira digests use the workspace connection. Connect them under Workspace admin.
team.digestsInviteTip: If digests fail with not_in_channel, invite the Silvervibe bot into the Slack channel.
team.peoplePurpose: Invite teammates by email. They join this team and can answer standups.
team.peopleEmptyBody: Send an invite so someone can answer the first standup.
team.todayPurpose: See who answered today and rebuild the AI summary when needed.
team.noTeamsBody: Create a team in Workspace admin, then come back here to set the schedule.

workspace.slackHint: Authorize Slack once and pick a default channel. Each team can override the channel in Team admin when addons.slack is enabled. After reconnecting with updated scopes, members can submit with /standup in Slack (same Neon standups as the web).
workspace.teamsHint: Paste a Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook URL. When a team summary is rebuilt (submit or Rebuild), it posts to that channel if addons.teams is enabled.
